title: AI shopping is mainstream, and our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of shoppers use AI in discovery (NIQ); Amazon adds 100+ Alexa shopping functions and Walmart upgrades Sparky; Visa finds AI models fail 43% of shopping tests. Chicony revenue fell 24% on PC component costs; Amazon raised seller fees.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream as Amazon and Walmart deepen their assistants
points.detail: 55% use AI in discovery (NIQ); Amazon added 100+ Alexa shopping functions and Walmart added visual recognition and cart generation to Sparky. Make our feeds and checkout agent-ready.

points.headline: Agent shopping is still unreliable, which makes a smooth checkout a differentiator
points.detail: Visa found AI models fail 43% of shopping test runs, while Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases. We should test how agents handle our store and win the checkout step.

points.headline: Memory and component costs weaken PC demand and squeeze margins
points.detail: Memory prices cut 2026 mobile SoC shipments nearly 20%; Chicony revenue fell 24% year on year on component costs; Acer is pushing accessories. Plan pricing, inventory and accessory attach.

points.headline: Marketplace costs rise while delivery and new channels expand
points.detail: Amazon raised seller fees and its fees and ads hit $66.1B in Q3; TikTok Shop launched an app. We should weigh channel margins and test new ones.
